chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to me from Muawiyah ibn Hakeem from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira from Abdullah ibn Muskan from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Whoever remembers Allah while in a state of ablution is like one who has performed a ritual bath.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for remembering Allah during ablution?
ai.summary: In *Thawab al-A'mal*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) to illustrate the transformative power of conscious devotion (*muraqabah*) during physical purification. By linking the minor ablution (*wudu*) to the major bath (*ghusl*), the Imam emphasizes that spiritual elevation is determined by the presence of heart rather than merely the external act, a concept central to Shia jurisprudence regarding the validity of acts of worship.
